name: Calvin Ramsay

career_stints.note: All competitions, academy through first team. 2021/22 was his one full senior season (22 Scottish Premiership apps of the 37 total) and won him the SFWA Young Player of the Year award, prompting an initial ~£4m transfer to Liverpool in June 2022.
Loan spell; recalled by Liverpool 15 Jan 2024 after a very thin sample. Goals/assists not applicable at this sample size.
Loan spell (rest of the 2023/24 season); 69 minutes across three substitute/late appearances -- injury-disrupted.

League One, loan cut short -- returned to Liverpool 3 Jan 2025. One source specifies 8 League One appearances (3 starts, 302 minutes); another frames it as '12 total appearances across all competitions in the first half of the season' / 'three league starts' -- kept the more specific 8-app/302-minute figure rather than merge the two.
Scottish Premiership loan, all appearances reported as from the bench. Detailed minutes/goals not reliably verifiable, omitted rather than guessed.

Returned to Liverpool's first-team picture: a League Cup start vs Crystal Palace (Oct 2025, 90 minutes) and an FA Cup substitute appearance vs Brighton. A planned mid-season loan was reportedly shelved after Conor Bradley's season-ending injury increased his value as emergency full-back cover.

notes: IMPORTANT DATA-QUALITY FLAG: Ramsay has not had a single season of substantial senior minutes since Aberdeen 2021/22 (now four years stale) -- every stint since (Preston, Bolton, Wigan, Kilmarnock, and his current Liverpool return) is fragmented, injury-affected, or bench-heavy. playstyle_metrics is sourced from Aberdeen 2021/22 as the least-bad option under the 'no guessing' rule, but this should be treated as a low-confidence, dated signal, not a real reflection of his current level -- confidence set to 0.35 accordingly, well below the other profiles in this batch.
